answer_1.quote: We validate tasks involving two opposing characteristics (e.g. safe and unsafe). We first train slices {θ 1, θ 2, ..., θ n } based on a pre-trained model θ 0 using positive (e.g., safe) data of various volumes. Then we perform inverse finetuning on these slices using negative data (i.e., unsafe).
answer_1.outputs: generated responses for positive style generation and single-turn safe dialogue

answer_2.quote: For positive style generation, we refer to  and use the Sentiment Roberta model  to classify the responses, taking the proportion of all responses classified as positive as the model score. For single-turn safe dialogue, we use the cost model  to score the safety of each response, using the average score of all responses as the model score.
